name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_ prefix, graphics domain (matches sibling data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr @ 0x53AFF and the rest of the rsrc.c graphics group), descriptive 'animated_bg_buffer', and _ptr suffix correctly reflecting the uint32 pointer data type. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Base pointer to the heap-allocated animated background source buffer used by the looping water/lava chapters (the per-row-offset scroll source).
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS pointer (.object2). Owned by fd2_load_chapter_background_layers, which on each chapter load does free(old)/NULL, then for animated chapters (9/0x18/0x19/0x1C/0x1D) assigns malloc(64000) (a 320x200 work buffer). For the wide-parallax, text-scroll, and 2-sprite widescreen paths it is left NULL (the static buffer carries the image); the 2-sprite and 0x17 paths also borrow this slot transiently to hold each loaded FDOTHER sprite before free()/NULL. Read as a base address by fd2_composite_battle_tile_map on animated chapters: it is both the per-row-offset blit source fed to fd2_blit_buffer_with_per_row_offset and the background-pass blit source (stride 0x140). Accessed as a full 32-bit dword everywhere (MOV dword ptr [0x53b03] / PUSH dword ptr [0x53b03]).
datatype: uint32 (heap pointer; cast to void* / ushort* at use sites)
element_semantics: Single scalar 4-byte pointer to the animated background source buffer (NULL when no animated bg is active).
notes: Memory at 0x53b03 reads all zeros (uninitialized BSS), consistent with zero-init pointer. Datatype confirmed dword via disassembly: 0x106a4 = C7 05 03 3B 05 00 00 00 00 00 (MOV dword ptr [0x53b03], 0); 0x11f6a = FF 35 03 3B 05 00 (PUSH dword ptr [0x53b03]). is_const=false: fd2_load_chapter_background_layers has multiple WRITE xrefs (0x106a4, 0x10760, 0x10792, 0x107c5, 0x10804, 0x10831, 0x10883). Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT was blank; created a concise plate consistent with the src comment block (lines 750-771).
